description: A visitor can learn what the application does from the homepage before signing in.
steps: Open the site's root URL (/) in a browser session with no signed-in user.
Verify that the homepage loads and its explanation is visible without signing in.
Verify that the explanation identifies the task the application helps users perform and the outcome users can expect.

description: A new user can create a candidate profile.
steps: Start with a signed-in user who has no candidate profile.
Complete and submit the profile form with valid details.
Reload the profile and verify it shows the details just submitted.

description: A candidate can upload a CV and view the details extracted from it.
steps: Sign in with a candidate profile and upload a supported CV with a known skill and experience entry.
View the extraction result and verify it shows the skill and experience present in the CV.

description: A candidate can provide the job description they are preparing for.
steps: Sign in with a candidate profile and submit a job description with a known role title and requirement.
Verify the submitted role and requirement are available for comparison with the candidate's CV.

description: A candidate can see how their CV matches their target job.
steps: Use a CV that demonstrates one job requirement and omits another.
Run the comparison against the submitted job description.
Verify the result displays a CV-fit score, cites evidence for the matched requirement, and flags the omitted requirement as a gap in the CV.

description: A candidate can see actionable CV improvements tied to the target job.
steps: Open a comparison with a flagged gap and a relevant experience entry that could be clearer.
Request CV improvements and verify the feedback identifies what to change and which job requirement it addresses.
Verify any suggested wording uses facts supported by the candidate's CV or profile.

description: A candidate can complete an assessment tailored to the target role and receive a score.
steps: Start an assessment for a submitted job description with a known requirement.
Verify that at least one assessment item evaluates that requirement, then submit responses.
Verify the result shows an assessment score and identifies an area to improve when a response falls short.

description: After each training session, the candidate can see what they demonstrated, what needs work, and what to practice next.
steps: For a target role with two required competencies, complete a diagnostic that demonstrates one competency and falls short on the other.
Open the session feedback and verify it shows the overall score and the score for each assessed competency once grading is complete.
Verify that the feedback identifies the demonstrated strength, cites the relevant answer for the weak area, and explains what the rubric expected.
Verify that the recommended next exercise targets the weak competency.
Complete guided practice and a reassessment. Verify that each shows feedback based on its own answers and labels any ungraded or untested competencies.

description: A candidate can practice weak areas and repeat the assessment until the readiness criteria are met.
steps: Complete an assessment that falls below the readiness criteria.
Verify that the site provides practice for a weak area and a way to take another assessment.
Submit another below-criteria attempt and verify that the practice and reassessment cycle remains available.
Submit an attempt that meets the criteria and verify that the site reports readiness for the selected role.

description: A candidate receives an updated CV for the target job after completing the qualifying training session and reaching readiness.
steps: Start preparation for a target job using a CV with a supported experience entry that can be clarified through an evidence-backed suggestion.
Complete a session that falls below the readiness criteria. Verify that session feedback is visible and the final updated CV is unavailable.
Complete the qualifying reassessment and verify that readiness is reported for the selected job.
Open the updated CV from the completed preparation result. Verify it reflects the supported improvement for the selected job and introduces no unsupported experience or qualifications.
Verify that the candidate can still access the original uploaded CV.

description: A candidate can return to their own saved preparation.
steps: Sign out after completing a session and reopen the preparation URL. Verify sign-in is required.
Sign back in and verify the role and session are restored. Open the URL as another candidate and verify the private result is inaccessible.

description: Candidates can check assessment coverage before purchase.
steps: Submit a job with a required competency missing from the reviewed question bank. Verify the missing skill is named and paid checkout is unavailable.
Submit a supported role and verify the preview shows the skills assessed, preparation terms, and final CV delivery condition.

description: Candidates can correct extraction errors before relying on CV feedback.
steps: Open a parsed CV where a project skill was attributed to employment. Inspect the source and correct the attribution.
Rerun the analysis and verify the cited evidence and suggested edit refer to the corrected project entry. Reload and verify the correction persists.

description: Candidates can trace progress on a job requirement across sessions.
steps: Complete two independent assessments and one assisted practice task for a required skill.
Open the target role and verify dated scores, supporting feedback, and the next exercise. Verify assisted results are labeled and excluded from readiness.
Switch roles and verify the original readiness result applies only to its target role.

description: A ready candidate can control what goes into their downloadable CV.
steps: Open the final CV with two suggested changes and inspect each change beside its supporting evidence.
Accept one edit, decline the other, and download the revision. Verify only the accepted change appears and the original remains accessible.

description: Candidates can buy a disclosed preparation package for a supported role.
steps: Verify checkout displays role, total price, currency, usage and refund terms. Cancel and confirm that paid access is inactive.
Complete a test payment and verify receipt and access for the selected role. Replay its confirmation and verify there is a single purchase and entitlement.
Sign back in and reopen the purchased preparation without paying again.

description: Candidates can recover the promised CV after an export failure.
steps: Simulate an export failure after the qualifying session. Reopen the result and verify readiness is retained.
Retry generation and download the revision for the same role without another assessment or payment.

description: Candidates can remove a preparation and its personal artifacts.
steps: Create two preparations with distinct CVs. Select one for deletion and inspect the stated retention terms and affected records.
Confirm deletion and verify its CV, answers, results and downloaded-file link are inaccessible from the service. Reopen the second preparation and verify its files remain available.

description: A buyer can recover access when checkout succeeds but confirmation is delayed.
steps: Complete a sandbox payment and delay the confirmation. Reopen the preparation and verify it shows payment pending, a support reference, and a way to check status.
Reconcile against the provider's confirmed transaction. Verify access and one receipt for the original order without repeating checkout.
Replay the confirmation after a confirmed refund. Verify the order shows refunded and paid access is not reactivated.

description: A candidate can recover a submitted assessment after grading is interrupted.
steps: Submit an unassisted assessment, interrupt grading, and reload. Verify the answers are saved and the attempt shows grading pending.
Retry the same submission from a second tab. Restore grading and verify exactly one score, one allowance debit, and one readiness contribution for that attempt.
Complete a separate fresh reassessment and verify the two qualifying attempts have distinct identifiers and question sets.

description: A candidate's current report reflects the selected job and CV revisions.
steps: Start a comparison, correct a CV attribution while it is running, and request a new comparison.
Complete the newer comparison first and deliver the older result last. Reload and verify the selected report still cites the corrected source.
Delete the preparation with an export pending. Complete the delayed export and verify neither the preparation nor its download reappears.

description: A candidate can request review of a disputed grade that affects readiness.
steps: Submit a valid alternate answer to a scored item and use a fixture where it receives a below-threshold grade.
Open the feedback, identify the disputed criterion, submit a review request, and verify its status survives reload.
Have the assigned reviewer record a corrected rating and reason. Verify the candidate sees the decision, updated breakdown and recalculated readiness, with the original attempt counted once.

description: A candidate can resume the same assessment without losing a confirmed answer.
steps: Open an assessment, enter two answers, wait for the saved indicator, and reload. Verify both answers, item order, and attempt ID are restored.
Edit the same answer in two tabs. Save the newer edit, then send the stale save. Verify the conflict is visible and the newer saved text survives.
Submit the attempt and replay an earlier draft save. Verify the submitted answers remain frozen.

description: Practice adapts to the error demonstrated in the candidate's work.
steps: Use a reporting diagnostic where the candidate groups correctly but loses categories with zero sales. Verify the next lesson targets preserving unmatched rows.
Repeat the same error after a hint. Verify feedback explains the error with a worked example, then offers a different exercise.
Solve the new practice task and verify the engine recommends an independent transfer task while readiness still awaits qualifying assessments.

description: Readiness reflects the latest qualifying evidence in submission order.
steps: Under the proposed pilot rubric, submit three independent reassessments for one blueprint in the order pass, fail, pass. Deliver their grades out of order and verify the candidate has one consecutive pass.
Add a guided practice session and verify the streak is unchanged. Submit another eligible pass and verify a single readiness decision and one CV generation request.
Repeat with an unresolved middle grade and verify final readiness stays pending until all relevant results are settled.

description: A candidate can see role-specific progress and take the next preparation action on desktop and mobile.
steps: Sign in with no preparation and verify the dashboard shows the first setup action.
Open a role with a completed CV comparison, a weak diagnostic result, and an in-progress assessment. Verify separate CV-fit and skill scores and that the primary action resumes the saved assessment.
Switch to a second role with a qualifying result and a failed CV export. Verify the first role's scores are cleared during loading and the selected role shows readiness and a retry action.
At mobile width, navigate by keyboard and verify the role selector, primary action, and session feedback links are visible and usable without horizontal scrolling.

description: A candidate can navigate questions, review missing answers, and confirm one assessment submission on desktop or mobile.
steps: Start an independent assessment with multiple questions. Answer one, move forward and back, and verify the saved answer and answered count.
At mobile width, open the question navigator using the keyboard, select an unanswered item, and verify focus reaches its prompt.
Open final review with one unanswered item. Verify the skip consequence is shown and return to edit an answer before confirming the skip.
Submit the reviewed attempt, reload during grading, and verify a single submission appears with pending status and later links to the session feedback.

description: A candidate can set the job titles to search for, either by entering them or by accepting titles identified from their uploaded CV.
steps: Sign in with a candidate profile that has an uploaded CV. Open job search and verify suggested titles derived from the CV's skills and experience are shown, each with the CV evidence it came from.
Remove one suggested title, edit another, and add a title manually. Save and reload, and verify the saved list matches the edits.
Sign in with a candidate who has no CV and verify that titles can still be entered manually and a search can run.

description: A candidate can see relevant listings gathered from multiple job sites in one place.
steps: Run a search for a saved title with at least two enabled sources returning known fixture listings.
Verify results from every source appear together, and each listing shows title, company, location, source name, and a link to the original posting.
Verify a listing returned by two sources appears once, with both sources shown.
Filter by source and by location and verify the list updates without a full reload.

description: A search still works when some job sources fail, and the candidate can see what was and wasn't searched.
steps: Run a search where one source times out, one rejects the request, and one succeeds.
Verify results from the successful source are shown and each failed source is named with a status and a retry action.
Retry the failed source after restoring it and verify its listings merge in without duplicating existing ones.
Verify previously fetched listings are labeled with when they were last updated.

description: Listings that have been closed or removed at the source are not presented as open.
steps: Save a listing, then simulate the source removing it.
Refresh and verify the listing is marked closed or unavailable, and that the saved tailored resume and notes for it remain accessible.
Verify closed listings are excluded from new search results by default.

description: A candidate can pick a discovered listing as their target job and get the same preparation features as a pasted job description.
steps: Open a listing from search results and choose it as a target job.
Verify its role title and requirements are available for CV comparison, as with a submitted job description.
Verify the CV-fit score, gaps, and role coverage preview run against that listing.

description: A candidate can see which keywords a listing emphasizes and which of them their CV already covers.
steps: Use a listing with known keywords and a CV that contains some of them.
Open keyword analysis and verify it lists the listing's keywords, marks each as present or missing in the CV, and cites where each present one appears.
Verify the result shows a keyword-coverage figure labeled as an estimate and not as a guaranteed ATS result.

description: A skill or keyword missing from the CV is added only after the candidate confirms they actually have it.
steps: Open keyword analysis with one missing keyword the candidate has and one they don't.
Verify each missing keyword is shown with options such as 'I have this', 'learning', and 'I don't have this', and that nothing is added to any resume before the candidate chooses.
Confirm the first keyword with a supporting detail, mark the second as not having it, and generate the tailored resume. Verify the confirmed skill appears and the other does not.
Verify keywords marked 'I don't have this' or 'learning' are surfaced as gaps linked to practice, not inserted into the resume.
Reload and verify the confirmations persist and can be changed.

description: A candidate can get a version of their CV with small, evidence-backed edits for a specific listing.
steps: From a selected listing with confirmed skills, request a tailored resume.
Verify the result shows each micro-edit as a diff beside the listing requirement or keyword it addresses and the CV or confirmed-skill fact that supports it.
Verify no edit introduces experience, employers, dates, or qualifications absent from the CV, profile, or confirmed skills.
Verify the original uploaded CV is unchanged and still accessible.

description: A candidate controls which micro-edits go into each tailored resume.
steps: Open a tailored resume with three suggested edits.
Accept one, decline one, and manually reword one. Verify the preview updates and the keyword-coverage figure reflects the current selection.
Download the resume and verify it contains only the accepted and reworded changes.
Reload and verify the decisions are preserved.

description: A candidate can keep a separate tailored resume for each listing and know which one was used where.
steps: Generate tailored resumes for two listings from different sources.
Open the saved variants list and verify each variant shows its listing, source, creation date, and keyword coverage.
Edit one variant and verify the other and the original CV are unchanged.
Download a variant in an ATS-safe plain format and verify the text is parseable, with standard section headings and no text in images or tables.

description: A candidate's search criteria, saved listings, and tailored resumes are private and are removed on deletion.
steps: Open another candidate's saved listings or resume variant by URL and verify access is denied.
Verify the CV text and personal details are not sent to any job source during search, only the job titles and filters.
Delete the preparation and verify its tailored resumes and confirmed-skill records are inaccessible, while a second preparation's remain.
